about.title: About
about.lead: ALL PDF is a free toolkit for everyday PDF work. Open it in a browser on any device, process files, download the result. No accounts, no subscriptions, no uploads to a server.
about.freeText: Every tool is available to everyone. No “3 files per day” or watermarks — only the technical limits below.
about.privacyText: Processing happens in your browser via WebAssembly and JS. Documents are sent nowhere.
about.offlineText: Install it as an app (PWA) — tools stay available without internet.
about.limitsText: Files up to 50 MB. Per run: up to 20 PDFs, up to 50 photos, OCR up to 10 files and 20 images, preview 20/50/100 pages. Language models download on first recognition. Encryption is real AES-128/256.

mergePage.title: Merge PDF & photos
mergePage.hint: Add PDFs and images, set the order with arrows and optionally pick pages per PDF. An empty field means the whole file.
mergePage.badFile: One of the files does not look like a PDF — remove it from the list.
mergePage.failed: Merge failed. Make sure the files are valid PDFs.

splitPage.title: Split & pages
splitPage.zipNote: Chunks download as a single ZIP.
splitPage.empty: No pages match these ranges. Check the numbers.

compressPage.title: Compress PDF
compressPage.grew: The result is larger than the original — better keep the original.
compressPage.note: Local lossless compression: removes duplicate objects and overhead. Full image recompression will arrive in future versions.

convertPage.photoLimit: Up to {{n}} photos at once, 50 MB each.
convertPage.scaleHint: 3× gives crisp images but may run out of memory on phones — pick 2× then.
convertPage.scaleWarn: Heads up: 3× may exhaust phone memory on large files. Pick 2× if it fails.
convertPage.noText: No text found — this looks like a scan without a text layer. Try the “OCR: scan → text” tool.
convertPage.truncated: Showing the first {{n}} pages — that is the preview limit.
convertPage.unsupportedFormat: HEIC and TIFF are not supported locally yet. Convert them to JPG/PNG on your phone and try again.

ocr.title: OCR: scan → text & PDF
ocr.hint: Upload photos, scans or a PDF. Recognition runs right in the browser. Language models (~15–30 MB, internet needed) download on first run, then it works offline. Max 10 files at a time.
ocr.capped: Taking the first {{n}} images — that is the per-run limit.
ocr.failed: Recognition failed. Check the files and connection (models download on first run).

editPage.title: PDF editor
editPage.author: Author
editPage.allPagesNote: “Watermark” and “Page numbers” apply to all pages. Text stamp goes on the chosen page or all pages (checkbox).
editPage.stampPreview: Preview: this is how the stamp lands on the page.
editPage.badPages: No such page: the file has {{n}} pp. Check the number or tick “all pages”.
editPage.failed: Could not apply. Check the page number.

signPage.title: Signature
signPage.hint: Draw with mouse or finger, then place into the PDF. Pick position and size in the preview below.
signPage.drawFirst: Draw the signature first — the canvas is still empty.

protectPage.title: Protect PDF (AES)
protectPage.hint: Real AES-128/256 encryption, password removal and metadata cleanup. All local.
protectPage.encDone: File encrypted — save it with the button below.
protectPage.decDone: Password removed — save the file with the button below.
protectPage.decFailed: Decryption failed. Check the password and file.
protectPage.sanitizeDone: Metadata cleared — save the file with the button below.

viewerPage.title: View PDF
viewerPage.hint: Preview of the first {{n}} pages. Changing zoom re-renders pages from scratch.
viewerPage.truncated: Showing the first {{n}} pages — that is the preview limit.

formsPage.title: PDF forms
formsPage.hint: Fill form fields right in the browser and download the finished document.
formsPage.flattenHint: Just remove interactivity without filling — e.g. to lock fields so they can't be changed.
formsPage.unsupported: This field type is not supported
formsPage.noFields: No form fields found — this is a regular PDF without interactive fields.

organizer.title: Page organizer
organizer.hint: Click to select, drag to reorder (on phones swipe or use the ‹ › arrows under each thumbnail). Rotate or delete the selection, then save.
organizer.truncated: Showing the first {{n}} pages — that is the limit.

images.title: Images from PDF
images.hint: Pull embedded pictures: JPEG as is, the rest as PNG. Very large images may use a lot of phone memory.

crop.title: Crop margins
crop.hint: Trim white borders and scan edges. Values are points (72 pt = 1 inch).
crop.previewHint: The blue frame is what remains after cropping. Change the numbers below — the frame follows.
crop.badRange: No pages match these numbers: the file has {{n}} pp. Check the input.

repair.title: Repair PDF
repair.hint: Rebuild the file's internal structure. Helps with open errors and truncated downloads.
repair.failed: Repair failed — the file is damaged beyond recovery.

compare.title: Compare PDFs
compare.hint: Upload two versions of a document — see line-by-line differences. The first {{n}} pages are compared.

tables.title: Tables to CSV (beta)
tables.hint: Heuristic for simple reports: rows and columns are guessed from coordinates. Always double-check the result.

shapes.title: Shapes & markup
shapes.hint: Draw with mouse or finger right on the page. Shapes are burned into the PDF on save. On phones the page won't scroll while you draw; pinch with two fingers to zoom.
shapes.tooSmall: Stroke too short — draw a longer one.
shapes.redactNote: Redaction is visual: a black rectangle is burned on top, but the source text underneath stays in the file. For legally binding removal use desktop tools.
